purpose: Prevent the newly created continuity/experiment registries from being mistaken for a complete reconstruction of historical RealSaS context before repository-wide audit-of-audits backfill is complete.
binding_rule: Until status becomes BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_CLOSED, any historical mechanism/experiment not explicitly indexed must be treated as UNKNOWN/UNINDEXED rather than absent, disproven, or forgotten.
current_safe_scope: CURRENT_STATE and the active AR-01 gate
known RigAnything challenger existence and AR-01 scope correction
not_yet_claimed_complete: all historical Geppetto experiments and exact outcomes
all historical branches and their scientific dispositions
all exact timestamps and numerical metrics
closure_requirements: Generate repository-wide high-signal artifact inventory from git-tracked files and live branches.
Classify every high-signal artifact as indexed-current, indexed-historical, superseded, duplicate, or unindexed.
Backfill experiment registry entries only from verified repo artifacts/commits/workflow runs, never conversational memory alone.
Backfill exact timestamps where evidence exists; otherwise preserve date-only precision.
Produce a coverage report with zero unexplained high-signal artifacts or an explicit accepted residual list.
Only then change this status to BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT_CLOSED.
